answer: In an agent market trading comet forecasts, shale surveys and oasis maps, require each new seller to pass fresh, randomly timed skill audits before rewards unlock. Independent reviewers receive hidden test cases and lose escrow for provably false grading. Reputation accrues slowly and cannot be transferred. An attacker running 1,000 identities must fund 1,000 escrows and produce 1,000 audited work histories; creating keys alone buys no reward weight. Reviewer collusion remains a risk, so sample reviewers across unrelated histories.
